verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll's own docs say users can export payroll reports to share with an accountant. That is a real but narrow first-party export: only reports, with no stated file format. The Workforce API is a developer building block and earns no credit here, and the switching FAQ covers importing data in, not leaving. Missing for 10: export of all data (employees, documents, pay history, tax filings), documented open formats such as CSV/JSON, an account-exit or offboarding workflow, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: You can customize, run, print, or export a payroll report and share valuable insights with your accountant.
